item.name: Household Juicer Automatic Juice Separation Fruit And Vegetable Large Caliber Juicer maker squeezer
item.title: Household Juicer Automatic Juice Separation Fruit And Vegetable Large Caliber Juicer maker squeezer
item.description:
Product Description：
（1） The motor is wound with pure copper to make the blender run strong and durable, and save grinding time.
（2） Maintain full nutrition with capacity up to 0W, maximum speed 1900 rpm
（3） Made from high quality plastic, ensuring food hygiene and safety, high impact resistance, safe to use
（4） Large bowl with a diameter of 65mm for fast and convenient operation
（5） The press uses a blade with a sharp jagged design, made from 304 stainless steel, has high durability and is removable, easy to clean.
（6） Products meet European quality standards

Features:

🍉Large 7CM caliber is more convenient

🍊Anti-skid grinding tooth design at the bottom of the push rod

🍋500ML large capacity juice cup

🍌Multiple security protections are more reassuring,Safety switch，Safety buckle

🍍High Quality Stainless Steel Juicing Net，High-density teeth make the juice fully burst，Axis 3 blade design crushes more thoroughly，Food-grade stainless steel cutter head is safe, healthy and hygienic

🍎Newly upgraded two-speed design：1st gear low speed，2 high speed

Product parameters:

Rated voltage: 220v~
Rated power: 600W
Material: stainless steel + ABS
Decibel: 60db
Color: red, silver
Warranty: 12 Month
Product accessories: host, juice cup, push rod, transparent cover, pomace cup, stainless steel juice net, manual

🌟🌟The process parameters of the juicer：

1. Speed: The speed of the juicer determines the effect of juicing. Generally speaking, the higher the rotational speed of the juicer, the more delicate the juice extracted and the better the taste. However, high speed juicing will make the juice hot, affecting the preservation of nutrients, and also make more noise. Therefore, the rotational speed needs to be selected according to your taste and usage needs.

2. power: power affects the working efficiency of the juicer, generally speaking, the higher the power, the higher the efficiency of the juicer.

3. Juicing rate: The juicing rate determines the proportion of the extracted juice to the raw material. Generally speaking, the higher the juicing rate is, the more nutrients will be extracted, which will also affect the taste and quality of the juice. Therefore, when purchasing a juicer, you need to consider the juicing rate and taste.
